title: Energy Ratio
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the ratio of the electron's energy after to before the emission of the negatron as 3.

title: New Orbit Description
description: Important Criteria: The student should qualitatively describe the new orbit as elliptical due to the change in potential energy.

title: Closest and Farthest Distances
description: Essential Criteria: The student must find the distances of closest and farthest approach as 1/3 and 1 in units of r_0, respectively.

title: Axes of Ellipse
description: Essential Criteria: The student must determine the major and minor axes of the new elliptical orbit as 4/3 r_0 and 2√3/3 r_0, respectively.

title: Energy Conservation Application
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply conservation of energy correctly to derive the equations for the new orbit.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in energy calculations, particularly in potential and kinetic energy terms.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all distances are expressed in consistent units, specifically in terms of r_0.
